body.item: provide fire extinguisher type 2a 10bc or equivalent.(905, 1001(n)hc)
body.nov_item_description: at each level of the building in the common area, visible and readily accessible from the path of egress, provide approved fire extinguishers with current inspection date tags. one extinguisher in the upstairs kitchen, and one extinguisher at the bottom of the interior wood stairway will fulfill this requirement (2 extinguishers)

all sleeping rooms and occupied space within this building, regardless of permitted occupancy status, are required to have operating smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, per section 911 sfhc and section 420 cbc, installed, maintained and tested by the building owner

at the ground floor breezeway, the primary egress is obstructed. there are personal items stacked over 6' high with a narrow path to the stairway. remove the personal items to eliminate vermin harborage and provide unobstructed egress. a clear path of at least 3 feet is required, and full operation of the gate.any storage in this area must be in vermin proof boxes.

body.item: affidavit required for carbon monoxide and smoke alarms (sfbc 420.4,907.2.22 & 3401.6.1)
body.nov_item_description: complete self certification for the installation of carbon monoxide and smoke alarms. form must be complete without substitution. submit to inspector at time of reinspection, or email to inspector.

in one of the upstairs bathrooms, the toilet has been taped closed, and a note installed which says to use other toilet. have a qualified professional, using approved methods and materials, repair the toilet so that works as designed. if there are repairs or replacements which require opening walls, floors or ceilings, plumbing permits will be required.

it is the property owner's responsibility to be present or direct his/her representative to attend the reinspection as scheduled on this notice of violation for the purpose of providing entry to the inspector of those areas not accessed during the initial inspection as specified, and/or to provide access to all areas cited within this notice. if the property owner cannot attend the scheduled reinspection (as specified on this notice) it is his/her responsibility to secure a different inspection time/date with the inspector, and provide all tenants with notification as required by california civil code section 1954 (san francisco housing code section 303(b)), if any dwellings, apartment units or guest rooms are to be accessed during the reinspection.

body.code_violation_desc: The legal use of this building is a R-3, single family dwelling on one floor of occupancy over basement. Presently there are two units on two floors of occupancy. An additional dwelling unit and a change of use/occupancy has occured in the basement area and consists of 2 bedrooms, a kitchen with a electric stove,a kitchen sink, a bathroom with a toilet, lavy and tub/shower which has been installed without the benefit of a permit. Permit research failed to produce evidence to show that any valid permits were issued to alter the building to its present use.  THE FOLLOWING CODE VIOLATIONS EXIST AT THIS PROPERTY: * NUISANCE(1001-d SFHC)  * WORK WITHOUT PERMIT (301 HC, 106A, 108.4.1 SFBC) * UNAPPROVED WIRING (SFHC 1001-e) * UNAPPROVED PLUMBING (SFHC-1001-f) * LACK OF REQUIRED SMOKE DETECTORS (SFHC-909) * IMPROPER FLOOR OF RESIDENTIAL OCCUPANCY (SFHC 1001-o) * NO EVIDENCE THAT THE REQUIRED ONE HOUR FIRE RESISTANT MATERIALS WERE CORRECTLY INSTALLED BETWEEN GROUND FLOOR OCCUPIED ROOMS AND PROPERTY LINE OR UPPER UNIT(601 SFHC). * NO APPROVED PERMANENT SOURCE OF HEAT IN  LIVING SPACE (701 SFHC) * LACK OF REQUIRED LIGHT AND VENTILATION IN A HABITABLE ROOM (504 SFHC) * LACK OF APPROVED SECOND MEANS OF EGRESS (801 SFHC)

repair drain pipes in garage(1001f hc)
body.nov_item_description: in the garage, close to the hot water heater, there is a drain pipe with a tee that has a broken pipe connected to it. have a qualified professional cap off the tee so that it is not open to the garage.

in the garage, the hot water heater installation does not meet applicable codes. have a licensed plumber obtain plumbing permits, and, using approved methods and materials, install the hot water heater so that it meets all applicable codes. have the installation inspected by the plumbing inspector. *completed plumbing permits required*

it is the property owner's responsibility to be present or direct his/her representative to attend the reinspection as scheduled on this notice of violation for the purpose of providing entry to the inspector of those areas not accessed during the initial inspection as specified, and/or to provide access to all areas cited within this notice. if the property owner cannot attend the scheduled reinspection (as specified on this notice) it is his/her responsibility to secure a different inspection time/date with the inspector, and provide all tenants with notification as required by california civil code section 1954 (san francisco housing code section 303(b)), if any dwellings, apartment units or guest rooms are to be accessed during the reinspection.

body.item: this notice includes violations for the areas noted.

body.nov_item_description: in the garage, there is recent electrical work, and all of the romex leaving the main panel, and the romex serving some of the outlets in the garage, is not protected by wallcoverings. also in the garage, there are open junction boxes. have a licensed electrical contractor obtain electrical permits, and using approved methods and materials, make changes to the electrical installation in the garage and contiguous spaces so that it meets all applicable codes, and then have it inspected by the electrical inspector. *completed electrical permits required*

in the garage, the electric clothes dryer is not vented to the outside. (1502.2 06 irc). have a qualified professional obtain building permits, and, using approved methods and materials, install a dryer vent which meets all applicable codes, and have it inspected by the building inspector. *completed building permits required*
